queries.name: dexterous-manipulation
queries.search_query: (all:"dexterous manipulation" OR all:"dexterous hand") AND (cat:cs.RO OR cat:cs.AI OR cat:cs.LG)

queries.name: force-tactile
queries.search_query: (all:"tactile manipulation" OR all:"force-aware manipulation" OR all:"impedance control") AND cat:cs.RO

queries.name: robot-vla
queries.search_query: (all:"vision-language-action" OR all:"vision language action") AND (all:robot OR all:manipulation)

queries.name: teleoperation-hardware
queries.search_query: (all:"dexterous teleoperation" OR all:"robot hand hardware") AND cat:cs.RO

sections.name: Dexterous Tool Use & Manipulation
sections.description: Multi-finger grasping, tool use, articulated or deformable object manipulation.

sections.name: Dexterous VLA / Vision-Language-Action
sections.description: Language-conditioned VLA models that directly support dexterous hands.

sections.name: Force-aware VLA / Tactile VLA
sections.description: VLA or language-conditioned systems using force, torque, or tactile sensing.

sections.name: VLM-guided Impedance Control
sections.description: VLM or LLM systems that generate, retrieve, or adapt impedance parameters.

sections.name: Learned Impedance / Variable Compliance Control
sections.description: Learning or optimization of stiffness, damping, compliance, or force control without a VLM backbone.

sections.name: VLA Foundation Models
sections.description: General VLA or visuomotor foundation models relevant to manipulation.

sections.name: RL-based Dexterous Manipulation
sections.description: Reinforcement-learning methods for dexterous grasping, reorientation, or long-horizon manipulation.

sections.name: Datasets
sections.description: Robot, force/tactile, human-hand, or cross-embodiment datasets.

sections.name: Simulation Benchmarks & Platforms
sections.description: Simulation platforms, benchmarks, or differentiable tactile/contact simulators.

sections.name: Teleoperation Systems
sections.description: Teleoperation interfaces and systems for collecting dexterous manipulation demonstrations.

sections.name: Low-Cost Dexterous Hand Hardware
sections.description: New dexterous-hand hardware, mechanisms, sensing, actuation, or low-cost designs.

sections.name: Tactile Representation Models
sections.description: General-purpose tactile encoders, representations, or tactile foundation models.
